Class PredatorManager

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.simulation.PredatorManager
public class PredatorManager extends Object
Manages all predators in the simulation. Handles spawning, AI updates, and predator-ant interactions.
Author:
Gemini AI Assistant, Silvère Martin-Michiellot
